test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e. **'Broke out'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sentence suggests** that during their time in the army, a war broke out.
 
• **"Broke out" **is a commonly used phrase to describe the sudden occurrence or start of a conflict, such as a war.
 
• **It indicates** that the war began or erupted.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *There were two **childhood** buddies who went through school and college and even joined the army together. War **broke out** and they were (3)________in the same unit. One night they were ambushed. Bullets were flying (4)________and out of the darkness came a voice, “Harry, please come and help me”. Harry (5)________recognised that voice of his childhood buddy*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "broke into,**" implies forcefully entering a place and is not suitable in the context of a war.
 
• **Option 2, "broke up,**" typically refers to the end or dissolution of something, such as a relationship or a gathering, and does not convey the idea of a war.
 
• **Option 3, "broke in,**" suggests forcibly entering a place, which is not applicable here.
